content.title: ‘The Masked Singer’ finale: Galaxy Girl wins Season 14; here’s who it is
content.text: Published April 1, 2026 10:30pm EDT 'The Masking Singer' finale: Galaxy Girl crowned the winner LOS ANGELES - The remaining four contestants of "The Masked Singer" battled it out during Wednesday night’s finale – but only one could be crowned the Season 14 winner and receive the coveted Golden Mask Trophy. The remaining celebrities included Cat Witch, Crane, Pugcasso and Galaxy Girl – but at the end of the night, Galaxy Girl was named the season’s champion. Who is Galaxy Girl on ‘The Masked Singer’? Big picture view: Ashlee Simpson, a pop-punk singer-songwriter, was the latest celebrity to be unmasked on Season 14 of the FOX singing reality competition. What they're saying: "I literally had the best experience of my entire life here," the 41-year-old told the audience. "I can’t even believe I won. Everyone is incredible." Galaxy Girl performs on the season finale of "The Masked Singer." (Credit: Michael Becker/ FOX) Simpson’s 2004 album "Autobiography" went 3x Platinum and was one of the year's best sellers. Her singles include "Outta My Head (Ay Ya Ya)", "Boyfriend" and "Pieces of Me". Simpson's reality show, "The Ashlee Simpson Show," offered fans a glimpse into her life as a celebrity and musician. "It’s shown me a lot, really for myself," Simpson told the audience while standing next to her sister Jessica Simpson during the reveal. "I appreciate you guys, because this is so amazing for me to just put that mask on and to perform which is my favorite thing to do was really, truly such an honor." Crane, Cat Witch and Pugcasso unmasked Dig deeper: Crane, Cat Witch and Pugcasso were also revealed during the Season 14 finale. RELATED: ‘The Masked Singer’ finale: Buffalos win Season 12 Crane was revealed as Fifth Harmony member Normani, Cat Witch was revealed as social media star Kylie Cantrall, and Pugcasso was revealed as former American Idol winner Phillip Phillips.
